_comment: The ffmpeg build tools/fetch-ffmpeg.ps1 fetches into artifacts/ffmpeg/bin for the tag-writer and fixture tests (T-136). A test tool, not a product dependency, so not in native-deps.json. The release publishes no digest: the hash was taken from the downloaded archive on 2026-09-13. Update url and sha256 together (tools/fetch-ffmpeg.ps1 -PrintHash). Essentials, not full: it carries every encoder tools/FixtureGen uses and is what the Chocolatey package installed before.
